proof_summary: Take \(p=13\): the required quadratic characters for the third case hold, and every integer representation \(13=3x^2+10y^2\) forces \(x^2=1\). Since \(\left(\frac{-1}{13}\right)=1\), the claimed residue is \(14\pmod{169}\), whereas direct evaluation of the finite sum gives \(138\pmod{169}\).
